783-2645-2872-3430.easyPrerequisites: Clever Conjurer doesn't have summoning sickness.
783-2645-2872-3430.description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Jungle Basin
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

107-4247-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Ambitious Aetherborn.
When Ambitious Aetherborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ambitious Aetherborn enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

129-1409-3755-4927.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

2034-4013-7293.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Palani's Hatcher.
When Palani's Hatcher enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

140-791-7433.description:
Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

997-4986-5915--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Stickytongue Sentinel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Stickytongue Sentinel enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Stickytongue Sentinel
Repeat.
997-4986-5915--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

2301-2438-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2301-2438-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Abzan Ascendancy and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2438-5220-6900-7286.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

4452-5147-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
4452-5147-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more +1/+1 counters on it

1812-4929-5455.description:
Activate Bristly Bill by paying {3}{G}{G}, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding eight {C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Prismite twice by paying {4}, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1274-3197-3330.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3197-3330.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2919-3197-6720.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3197-6720.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

222-413-527-955.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-413-527-955.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala enter, Slimefoot and Squee triggers once and Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve both Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1808-2837-3967.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1808-2837-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first Eloise trigger, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Resolve the second Eloise trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

369-2438-4775.notablePrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-2438-4775.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1863-3946-4011.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

1235-2239-5184-5195.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, targeting Ardent Elementalist.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve Twinflame, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist with haste.
When the Ardent Elementalist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Twinflame to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

2724-3194-3632.description:
Activate Erratic Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, triggering its first ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta enters the battlefield, but its first ability does not trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Repeat each turn.

262-643-1552.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Brimstone Trebuchet.
Brimstone Trebuchet does not have summoning sickness.
262-643-1552.description:
Activate Brimstone Trebuchet by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
The Elemental enters the battlefield as a Knight due to Maskwood Nexus, triggering Brimstone Trebuchet, untapping Brimstone Trebuchet.
Repeat.

2816-3430-3586.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Magus Lucea Kane.
Magus Lucea Kane does not have summoning sickness.
2816-3430-3586.description:
Activate Magus Lucea Kane by tapping it, adding six {C}.
Activate Magus Lucea Kane by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
You may then cast a spell or activate an ability with {X} in its mana cost, getting infinite copies of that spell or ability.

2034-2792-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{B}.
2034-2792-5140.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Great Whale, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

364-1987-4125-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

567-1734-4279-4681.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Soul's Attendant.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Soul's Attendant.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Soul's Attendant.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve both remaining Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain two life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability from step 5, putting a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature and drawing a card.
Repeat from step 5.
